/**
 * @name Trace eval usage to public API
 * @description Find calls to functions containing eval and trace back to public entry points
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/eval-call-chain
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

// Find the _eval_with_owner function
Function getEvalWithOwnerFunction() {
  result.getName() = "_eval_with_owner" and
  result.getLocation().getFile().getBaseName() = "typing_extensions.py"
}

// Find calls to _eval_with_owner
from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function f
where 
  f = getEvalWithOwnerFunction() and
  call.getFunction().(DataFlow::AttrRead).getObject().asExpr().(Name).getId() = "_eval_with_owner"
  or
  call.getFunction().asExpr().(Name).getId() = "_eval_with_owner"
select call, "Call to _eval_with_owner at line " + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Tracing calls to functions containing eval() to understand the attack surface
